Values: This scheme has now been discontinued. Funding for 2027/28 Access Postgrad scholarships will not be available.
Funding already allocated for 2026/27 will not be affected.
Scholarship awards to help towards the cost of tuition fees for students who have completed the Access Postgrad scheme in their final year of undergraduate study at the University.
The intention of the award is to provide students who would not normally be able to access postgraduate study with financial support to pursue their academic interests.
Ten awards will provide eligible students with a scholarship of up to £5,000 towards the cost of 2026/27 tuition fees.
These awards have been generously funded through donations by alumni and friends to the University.
To be eligible for this award, you must complete the University of Bristol’s Access Postgrad scheme.
be a final-year undergraduate student at the University of Bristol in 2025/26.
undertake a one-year, full-time or two-year part-time postgraduate taught programme at the University of Bristol (on a MA, MSc, LLM, MRes programme).
meet one or more of the University's widening participation criteria.

Values: Free accommodation for up to three years for students who have previously been in care or are estranged from their parents.

The University of Bristol is pleased to partner with The Unite Foundation to offer the Unite Foundation scholarship. The Unite Foundation supports estranged and care-experienced students with a rent-free #HomeAtUniversity for up to three years through a nationwide scholarship scheme.
You can apply for the scholarship if you are:
a statutory care leaver, care experienced (Scotland), or estranged from your family
starting or studying your first undergraduate degree
eligible for UK home fee status
applying to one of the Unite Foundation’s partner universities (this includes University of Bristol)
Current students who meet the eligibility criteria can also apply for the scholarship.
Applications for the Unite Foundation Scholarship are now closed for 26/27.
The new application cycle will open on 1 January 2027. Applications typically close early June.
The Unite Foundation cannot provide awards for every eligible young person.

An eligible application offers a chance and not a guarantee of a scholarship award. If your eligible application is unsuccessful initially, you will be put on the reserve list and can go through the adjustment and clearing process. You can also reapply the following year.
If you have any questions, email
Further information is available on the

Scholarships are reviewed on a regular basis and the Unite Foundation reserves the right to withdraw, amend or introduce new scholarships at any time. Scholarships are offered subject to funding and availability.

Every young person should have the opportunity to succeed whatever their background. Too few young people estranged from family or leaving care realise their potential at university. We want to change that.
